title: Glass-Bottom Boats Legacy
description: Legacy Port of Xeadas's Glass-Bottom Boats
body:
A legacy port of [Xeadas's Glass-Bottom Boats](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/xeadas-glass-bottom-boats/)

This texture pack changes the boat texture to have a glass bottom to see underwater and changes the item texture to have a glass bottom

Although, the water is still visible while seeing through the glass unlike the Original resource pack

**Using this texture pack on a Minecraft version not _(yet)_ supported will make some items appear different!**
